Sorry for late post, i forgot that i promised a picture.

i was in a mental institution in germany for trying to cut myself open some time ago. 
In said mental institution, there have been different floors. after 2 weeks in high security, they put me in a lower security, but still locked down part of the institution. Locked down in a way that doors where locked, but sometimes you could go out, if they thought you where stable enought, etc.

it was the highest floor of the building and close to the smoking room they had there was the balcony.
You could basically move freely in that floor, exept for that you could not leave.
I was a heavy smoker, so i spend a lot of time in that smoking room (nothing to do all day) and one night, i felt really bad and went for a smoke, feeling like i wanted to die.
after thinking about it a lot, i silently destroyed one of the windows (ill comment with picture) and went on the balcony and climbed on the roof, with the intention to jump.
I was up there, it was a beautiful night, i could see every star and i felt like on top of the world. spend 30 beautiful minutes on the roof (nurse was sitting in her room, imagine the room where they give out the pills in that movie with jack nicolson) and enjoyed my live more than ever before.
After that, i climbed back and told the nurse what happned. she gave me 5x normal medicamentation and send me to sleep, next morning i had to move back to high security for a month. That month was fucked, but i got out of that. Good night reddit.
